name: Ramstein
label: Quest
description: Ramstein: the quest giver's words, read aloud by the Lore Forever narrators.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: I was overwhelmed. On this very stead, I stood... Held my ground in defense of Lordaeron. The farm and all on it were waylaid by a gigantic wave of Scourge.
The wretch. The filth. It hovered above me, entrails hanging from its gaping chest cavity.
I woke as Scourge. For so long I was helpless. My mind had coalesced with the Lich King's.
She came for me... Somewhere, somehow, I knew she would. Free.
And now, I must have my vengeance - my vengeance on that which took from me my life. Destroy it.

clips.title: Progress
paras: After Sylvanas freed me, I hunted the beast across these wastes for months. It fled to the safety of Stratholme. The bastard...

clips.title: Completion
paras: I wonder... Did it beg for mercy? Could it know what mercy is?
I will hang this beast's head upon my wall.
You have earned a spot amongst one of my champions, friend.
